title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, web UI, and MCP server. It allows developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend with FastAPI for REST services, SQLite-vec for vector storage, sentence-transformers for embeddings, and a static HTML/JS frontend. Deployment uses AWS S3, CloudFront, and Lambda for OAuth/logging. Indexing is automated via GitHub Actions.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, configure a GitHub token, index your repositories using the CLI, and serve the web UI or integrate the MCP server into AI agents like Claude Code for context-aware code discovery.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Client-side semantic search using TF-IDF and embeddings
Auto-clustering of repos into capability categories
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
Exportable search results and embeddable widgets
